alarm.help.title: What do I do?

run.reason.not_connected: Not connected to the inspection. Please wait.
run.reason.locked: This product is locked. Call your supervisor.
run.reason.no_camera: No camera. Check the camera cable and power.
run.reason.plc_lost: PLC not connected. Check the network cable.
run.reason.sign_in: Sign in first. Tap Operator at the top right.
run.reason.no_rights: You may not do this. Call your supervisor.
run.reason.no_answer: No answer from the inspection yet. Look at the top bar before you try again.
run.reason.refused: Not allowed now. Call your supervisor.

changeover.accept.name: Your name

run.tip.ask_again: The values are right: ask the supervisor to check them again.
help.run.title: Run screen
help.run.body: The big sign shows the last part: green ✓ OK is good, red ✗ NG is bad. Press Start to check parts and Stop to stop. Change product picks what the line makes. A yellow line at the bottom says what to check.
product.title: Change product
product.none: No products yet. Call your engineer.
display.title: Language, colours and sound
display.reduce_motion_hint: Fewer moving effects. Windows' own setting does the same.
signin.title: Sign in
signin.pin_short: The PIN has at least {0} digits.
signin.refused: Sign-in not possible. Call your supervisor.
signin.card_hint: Tap your card on the reader, or enter your PIN.
signin.name: Name
signin.wrong_password: Name or password not right. Try again.
signin.card_unknown: This card is not known. Enter your PIN or call your supervisor.
runtime.refused.plcOff: The PLC is not connected: it would not see the test signal.
runtime.refused.plcRunEnable: The PLC has RunEnable on: switch the line to set-up on the PLC first.
runtime.refused.plcBusy: A part is being handled with the PLC: wait until it is done.
runtime.refused.plcLatchedNg: An NG signal is on: the OK test waits until it ends.
runtime.refused.changeover: The supervisor must check this changeover first.
runtime.changeover.localOnly: A changeover can be accepted here only at the line PC.
runtime.changeover.notApprover: Only a supervisor, quality person or admin can accept a changeover.
runtime.changeover.samePerson: You cannot accept your own changeover. A second person must do it.
runtime.changeover.notNow: The changeover cannot be accepted here now. Look at the message on the Run screen.
runtime.refused.noJob: This product is not there any more. Call your engineer.
runtime.refused.noProduct: This product is not there any more. Call your engineer.
batch.title: Start batch: enter what is printed on this batch
batch.none: This product needs nothing entered for the batch.
batch.reason.running: Press Stop first. The batch is changed only while the line is stopped.
batch.reason.refused: The batch could not be saved. Check the product is chosen and try again.
design.title: Engineer workspace
design.name: Name
design.pick_job: Open a job, or type a name and press New job.
design.name_first: Type a name for the new job first.
design.name_taken: A job with this name exists. Open it, or choose another name.
design.new_saved_later: New job with two cameras. Add the tools, try them on pictures, then press Save.
design.max_cameras: A job has at most 4 cameras.
design.pictures_folder: Stored pictures folder (on the line PC)
design.blob.exclude_edge: Leave out spots on the area's edge
design.blob.outline_hint: Teach (F7) on a good part teaches the outline of the first spot; Teach a spot teaches the spot you click. Then Auto tolerance sets the limits from good pictures. Crosses on the picture mark each spot's deepest dent and largest deviation, red when over the limit.
design.blob.teach_spot_tip: Then click one of this tool's numbered spots on the picture: its outline is taught.
design.blob.pick_spot: Click a numbered spot of {0} on the picture to teach its outline.
design.blob.try_first: The job changed since the spots were numbered. Press Try, then click the spot.
design.blob.no_spot_here: No spot of this tool there. Click inside a numbered spot, or press Try first so the spots are numbered.
design.blob.needs_calibration: Sizes in mm need the camera's calibration. Calibrate the camera first, or keep px.
design.blob.cannot_convert: The limits are in mm and the camera has no calibration, so they cannot be changed to px. Clear the limits first.
design.blob.no_calibration: The camera has no calibration: outline values are in px.
design.blob.auto_tolerance_tip: Measures the taught outline on the pictures that passed Try all pictures (or all stored pictures) and suggests the limits. Use pictures of good parts only.
design.blob.teach_first: Teach the outline on a good part first (Teach, F7).
design.blob.three_pictures: Auto tolerance needs at least 3 pictures of good parts.
design.blob.no_suggestion: No suggestion: every picture must show one whole outline of the part.
design.blob.suggestion: Suggested: largest deviation {0} {2}, largest dent {1} {2}, from {3} pictures (worst good: {4} and {5}). Now: {6} and {7}.
design.blob.accepted: {0}: limits set from good pictures. Undo (Ctrl+Z) takes them back.
design.blob.unit_changed: The outline unit changed since this was measured. Ask Auto tolerance again.
run.reason.runtime_old: The inspection on this PC is too old for this. Update it, then try again.
design.press_try: Choose a picture and press Try.
design.no_pictures: No stored pictures for this camera. Set its pictures folder and press Load pictures.
design.run_all: All pictures: {0} OK, {1} NG; slowest {2} ms.
design.pick_tool: Pick a tool on the left, or add one.
design.expected_hint: Empty: any content. {GTIN} takes the batch value.
design.gs1_ais: AIs the code must carry, e.g. 01, 17, 10, 21
design.polarity: Print colour (laser on a dark pack: LightOnDark)
design.letter_height: Letter height in pixels (0 = find it)
design.lines_check_hint: Each line as it should be printed. {BATCH} takes the batch value; Plc or Tool takes it from the PLC or another tool.
design.lines_read_hint: Each line's format, e.g. B.NO {A:1}{D:5} or EXP {EXP:MM/YY}.
design.drop.try_first: Try a picture first, then drop the tool on it.
design.drop.left_code: The area is left where the tool was dropped: draw it round the code, or press Teach.
design.drop.left_text: The area is left where the tool was dropped: draw it round the print, or press Teach.
design.drop.save_first: {0} was dropped where nothing was found: draw its area or press Teach before saving.
design.area_hint: Drag on the picture to draw the area this tool looks in.
design.try_batch: Values to try with: batch values, and PLC501=... for the PLC's text at a register (empty: those entered at the line)
design.no_rights: Only an engineer may change jobs. Sign in as an engineer.
ws.tip.grab: Take a picture with this camera and keep it with its pictures (the line must be stopped)
ws.tip.find_all: Find every code and text on this picture and offer a tool for each
ws.tip.find_window: Drag a window on the picture: tools are offered for what is in it
design.find_window_hint: Drag a window round what to check.
design.found: Found {0} to check in {1} ms. Accept what should be checked.
design.found_none: Nothing to check was found here. Drag a window round a code or text, or add a tool from the toolbox.
design.accepted: Added: {0}. Check what it reads, then save the job.
parts.title: Parts
parts.summary: {0} parts listed: {1} good, {2} bad, {3} same code
parts.kept: The newest {0} parts stay in this list and the newest {1} are shown. Every part is also kept for the reports.
parts.empty: No parts yet. Each part checked appears here.
parts.gap.missed: {0} parts are not in this list. They are kept for the reports.
parts.gap.link: Not connected. Parts checked until the link is back are not in this list.
design.saved_as: Saved as {0}, version {1}. Its PLC number is empty: give it its own number.
design.never_saved: This job was never saved: there is nothing to reload.
design.drop_changes: Drop the changes since the last save?
run.tip.batch: Enter what is printed on this batch (F3)
run.batch.none: This product has no batch values
run.plc.no_part: No part from the PLC yet
run.plc.unknown: Not known: the runtime is not connected
run.plc.tip.test: Sends OK or NG with Done to the PLC for 2 s so its wiring can be checked without parts. Only while the line is stopped; it is no part and is not counted.
run.plc.test.question: This will send a signal to the machine. Is the machine safe?
run.plc.test.sent_ok: Test OK sent to the PLC for 2 s. It is not counted as a part.
run.plc.test.sent_ng: Test NG sent to the PLC for 2 s. It is not counted as a part.
run.plc.test.no_link: The PLC is not connected: it would not see the test signal.
run.plc.test.run_enable: The PLC has RunEnable on: switch the line to set-up on the PLC first.
run.tip.batch_plc: What is printed on this batch, and the signals from the PLC
run.tip.setup: Lens, light and pixels checked on one or two pictures taken when this job was loaded
run.setup.checking: Taking pictures to check the lens, light and pixels for this job…
run.setup.stopped: The setup check was stopped when Start was pressed.
run.setup.no_picture: No picture to check: {0} The line can still run.
run.setup.dark_light: Outside a run the PLC may keep the light off: check with the light on.
run.setup.unmeasured: {0} found nothing to measure. Put a part under the camera to check its pixels.
run.setup.good: Lens, light and pixels are good.
run.setup.note: Advice only: Start is not stopped by it.
run.chart.no_parts_hour: No parts in the last 60 min
design.set.stopped: Stopped after {0} of {1} pictures: no margin from a part of the set.
design.set.empty: Press Try all pictures (F6) to run the job on every stored picture of this camera.
ws.title: Engineer workspace
ws.tip.toolbox_tile: Drag onto the picture: the area snaps to the code or text there (a Blob tool stays where it is dropped). Or click, then draw the area.
ws.toolbox.more: Locate, Measure and AI tools join the toolbox as they are built.
ws.no_result: Try the picture (F5) to see this tool's result.
ws.tools_time: {0} ms for {1} tools on this picture
ws.tip.picture_check: Picture check: sharpness and light of the four corners and the centre, with advice for the lens and the light. Advice only: it never changes a tool or a result.
ws.pc.advice.tilt: Blurred: {0}; sharp elsewhere. Check that the camera and lens are square to the part and the part lies flat, or the lens is not sharp at its edge.
ws.pc.advice.focus: Whole picture is blurred: focus the lens, or the part moved.
ws.pc.advice.clean_lens: Whole picture is soft and dull: clean the lens or the window in front of it.
ws.pc.advice.vignetting: All corners darker than the centre: open the aperture a little, move the light or use a wider light.
ws.pc.advice.bright: Too bright: {0}. Adjust the light, or remove the glare there.
ws.tip.new: Make a new job with this name
ws.tip.try: Run this camera's tools on the picture (F5)
ws.tip.try_all: Run the job on every stored picture of this camera (F6)
ws.tip.teach: Set up the selected tool from this picture of a good part (F7)
ws.tip.whole: The tool looks at the whole picture
ws.zoom_fit: Whole picture (Ctrl+0; right or middle button drags the picture)
ws.zoom_100: 100 %: one camera pixel per screen pixel (Ctrl+1)
ws.zoom_slider: Zoom from the whole picture to 16 times
ws.pan_tool: Pan: the left button or one finger drags the picture (arrow keys move it too)
ws.overview: The whole picture: drag the box to move the view
ws.full.none: Full picture not available: the reduced picture is shown enlarged
ws.essential.tip: Only the settings that matter most (3-5 per tool)
px.advice: {0}: needs {1}× more pixels: camera {1}× nearer, {2}, or a camera with {3}× the pixels
px.lens.mm: a {0} mm lens instead of {1} mm
px.lens.factor: a lens with {0}× the focal length
px.unsure: At this size the read is unsure.
px.accept.tip: Keep this tool with fewer pixels than it needs; recorded with your name and the time when the job is saved
design.saved.advice: Advice on the picture last tried ({0}) is in Messages; it does not stop the job.
review.title: Supervisor review
review.accept.tip: The part was good: the check should have passed it. Its picture teaches the job.
review.confirm.tip: The part is bad: the check was right. Its picture teaches the job what bad looks like.
review.looks_bad: The software found this part clearly bad. Look again before you accept it.
review.record_only.tip: Keep your decision as a record. A part the software finds clearly bad never teaches the job.
review.done.ok: Accepted: the job will learn that this part is good.
review.done.record: Accepted as a record only: not used for learning.
review.counts: Reviewed on this camera: {0} accepted, {1} confirmed NG, {2} record only
review.learn.tip: Work out settings that pass the accepted parts and still fail every confirmed bad part. The line must be stopped.
review.learning: Learning from the reviewed pictures… This takes a while.
review.learned: Check the changes, then Apply. The job is saved as a new version.
review.apply.tip: Save the job with these settings as a new version (line stopped).
review.applied: Saved {0}, version {1}. The line runs it from the next start.
review.zoom: Mouse wheel or + / − zoom, right button drags
review.camera_unknown: This picture's camera is not in the open job. Change to its product to learn from it.
areas.title: Areas and values
areas.empty: No area yet: drop a tool from the toolbox on the picture, draw one, or find everything.
areas.suggested: Suggested format: field type and pattern, or the code's GS1 elements
areas.tip.use: Puts the suggested format in the job draft; the running job changes only when you save
runtime.refused.idleMinutes: The idle time must be 2 to 60 minutes.
review.percent: Acceptable (good parts passing): {0} → {1}. Not acceptable (bad parts rejected): {2} → {3}.
review.unreadable: The software could not read this part. Check it again: accept it as good only if you are sure, or keep it as a record only.
review.accept_checked: Checked: part is good, learn from it
review.accept_checked.tip: You looked again and the part is good. Its picture teaches the job to pass parts like it.
run.tip.learning: Sort the saved good and bad pictures and learn from them (supervisor)
run.learning.notice: Line idle: {0} pictures waiting for supervisor sorting
run.learning.supervisor: Only a supervisor may sort pictures and start learning.
sort.none: No pictures wait to be sorted.
sort.software.ok_near: {0}, {1}: the software passed this part, close to a limit
sort.image.gone: This picture is no longer kept.
sort.accept.tip: The part is good (A). Its picture teaches the job to pass parts like it.
sort.reject.tip: The part is bad (R). Its picture teaches the job to fail parts like it.
sort.skip.tip: Leave this picture unsorted and show the next one
sort.zoom: Mouse wheel, two fingers or + / − zoom; drag to move the picture
sort.done.escape: Rejected. The software had passed this part: a bad part may have left the line. The plant has been told.
sort.learn.tip: Work out settings that pass the accepted parts and still fail every rejected part, proved on the sorted pictures. The line must be stopped, or idle with the PLC's RunEnable off.
sort.learn.stop.tip: End learning now; nothing is proposed
runtime.refused.supervisorApplies: A supervisor applies what was learned. Ask your supervisor.
sort.settings.enabled: Keep good pictures for learning and offer the sorting
sort.off: The learning session is off: no good pictures are kept and none are offered for sorting. Turn it on in the setting below.
run.review.waiting: {0} bad parts wait for a review
run.review.waiting_flagged: {0} bad parts wait for a review ({1} marked Was OK)
run.tip.review_waiting: Open the bad parts that no supervisor has decided yet
ng.was_ok.tip: I think this part was good. Your supervisor will look at it; nothing changes on the line.
ng.was_ok.done: Marked Was OK. Your supervisor will look at it.
sort.filter.was_ok.tip: Bad parts an operator marked Was OK
sort.filter.reviewed.tip: Pictures already decided: change or remove a decision
sort.reviewed.record: Accepted as a record only, not learned from ({0}, {1})
sort.reviewed.remove.tip: The picture no longer teaches the job and waits for a review again. Learn again before Apply.
remote.request.confirm_title: Remote service asks to change this
remote.request.confirm_check: Allow this change on this machine?
remote.request.approve_check: The recorded values stay as they are; the correction is added next to them with your name.
